expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Splits around the first matching Needle in SearchDir and reports whether one was found. @param OutLeft, OutRight Receive text before and after the match. Returns a copy with every matching From substring replaced by To. Replaces matches in place and returns the replacement count. Joins array elements with Separator between adjacent strings. Formats a finite float without unnecessary trailing zeroes while retaining the minimum fraction digits. Creates a one-code-unit string. Creates a string containing NumCharacters copies of Char.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Explicit arguments for every overload, default-argument omission where published, and valid/null context variants when handles or WorldContext are involved.
testScope: bool FString.Split(const FString& Needle, FString& OutLeft, FString& OutRight, ESearchCase SearchCase = ESearchCase::IgnoreCase, ESearchDir SearchDir = ESearchDir::FromStart) const; | FString FString.Replace(const FString& From, const FString& To, ESearchCase SearchCase = ESearchCase::IgnoreCase) const; | int FString.ReplaceInline(const FString& SearchText, const FString& ReplacementText, ESearchCase SearchCase = ESearchCase::IgnoreCase); | FString FString::Join(const TArray<FString>& StringArray, const FString& Separator); | FString FString::SanitizeFloat(float64 InFloat, int32 InMinFractionalDigits = 1); | FString FString::Chr(int16 Ch); | FString FString::ChrN(int32 NumCharacters, int16 Char);
